title: feat: show tool-calling model capability
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows the existing `tool_calling` capability on shared desktop and mobile model cards
- Uses a generic tool icon without conflating it with Pollinations MCP tools
- Adds focused rendering coverage

Checks:
- `npx vitest run test/pricing-data.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-enter`
- `npm run build:frontend --workspace pollinations-enter`

gist.headline: Tools, plainly labeled
gist.blurb: Model cards now show which models can call tools. No mysterious capability pollen required.
gist.summary: Shared desktop and mobile model cards now display the existing `tool_calling` capability with a generic tool icon, distinct from Pollinations MCP tools.
gist.impact: People choosing a model can now spot tool-calling support directly in the model picker on desktop and mobile.
gist.visual_concept: Polli wears a tiny mechanic tool belt and points at a cozy retro model-selection board where one model card has a simple wrench icon. Small code-plants and flowers grow around the terminal, while the monitor robot eagerly holds a generic tool badge, making the newly visible capability feel clear rather than tied to a specific tool system.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny mechanic tool belt, pointing at a retro terminal's model cards; one card clearly shows a simple wrench capability icon while a friendly CRT monitor robot holds a matching badge. Lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently among pastel mint, lavender, and warm cream code-plants and flowers; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'TOOLS'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
